newsitem.title: USA: Commodore names Edwin Harper president.
newsitem.headline: Commodore names Edwin Harper president.

text.p: Commodore Environmental Services Inc said Monday that Edwin Harper has been named president, chief operating officer and a director of the company.
Harper succeeds Paul Hannesson as president. Hannesson will remain as the company's chairman and chief executive, spokeswoman Melissa Berkowitz said.
Harper was chief financial officer of the Campbell Soup Co and was also Campbell's co-chief executive in late 1989 and early 1990, Commodore said.
Commodore said Harper also served in the White House, first as a special assistant under Richard Nixon and later as deputy director of the Office of Management and Budget under Ronald Reagan.
For the past five years Harper has been president of the Association of American Railroads, the company said.
